direction_basis: User requested continuation and preparation to pivot to the preceding operational-mission goals.
working_first_audience: Educator/preceptor; strategic planning assumption, not an independently approved audience or a measured market result.
demonstration_topic: Evaluating AI-generated learning material; current demonstration, not a newly approved topic.
outcome: A nurse starts without technical help, creates a useful source-linked teaching card, understands its limits, closes the app and returns to continue.

tasks.title: Put the teaching card inside the learning mission
tasks.deliverable: An in-memory, source-linked teaching-card draft derived from the existing learning choice, alongside the supporting review note.
acceptance: Use the existing validated choice and selected source context; no duplicated decision entry or raw reflection ingestion.
All four choices remain valid; reject/withhold must not be silently converted into a positive recommendation.
A one-page preview preserves disclosures and sources; long content prompts editing instead of clipping or unreadably small text.
Changed goal, sources or choice makes the derivative stale; pause, clear and reload retain their disclosed behavior.
No download/export, save, publication, native runtime, inference or approval is enabled in this first prototype.
tasks.scope: First bounded implementation target after explicit activation of this prepared lane; synthetic/public-source draft only. Educator review remains necessary before use claims.
tasks.owner_role: Frontend/core engineer with educator product review
tasks.could_weaken: A polished card can disguise unsupported claims or look reviewed.

tasks.title: Create the maintained first source-and-learning pack
tasks.deliverable: A small, rights-checked source pack with concepts, balanced exercises, teaching-card mapping, independent review and maintenance responsibility.
acceptance: Separate source evidence from instructional design and measured educational effectiveness.
Include warranted agreement, material omission and genuine uncertainty; no answer-choice success score.
Record retrieval, excerpting, adaptation, redistribution and model-training permissions separately.
One independent educator disposition and actual scope/audience confirmation; no invented reviewer or observed result.
tasks.scope: Commission-ready work order; no supplier is hired or material ingested by preparation.
tasks.owner_role: Health-sciences librarian and independent nurse educator
tasks.could_weaken: Unreviewed volume, licensing ambiguity or unpaid maintenance burden.

tasks.title: Make private save, close and resume truthful
tasks.deliverable: One owned workspace with durable mission/choice/card records, read-back and recovery; extend Florence-X responsibilities rather than use chat history as the portfolio.
acceptance: G-01 and applicable G-02 requirements satisfied before an operational writer is enabled.
Authentic actor, destination ownership, exact action/policy/approval binding and pre-dispatch audit are demonstrated.
Crash/interruption, duplicate requests, concurrent conflict, denied/revoked/stale approval and unknown outcome are tested against the real adapter.
Close/reopen preserves the exact mission, source versions, limitations and review state; changed derivatives do not inherit old review.
Begin with one authoritative local workspace; encryption/key recovery/backup/deletion decisions are explicit, not assumed from database choice.
tasks.scope: Design may precede gate resolution; operational implementation/activation remains gated. No persistence flag is flipped in fixture models.
tasks.could_weaken: False saved status, approval replay, unbounded recovery or hidden storage exposure.

tasks.title: Ask briefly, explain the proposed journey
tasks.deliverable: Progressive first-run discovery, an editable preference projection and a plan using real reviewed mission assets.
acceptance: Separate self-report, task evidence and independent assessment; role choice grants no credentials or institutional access.
Reuse confirmed teaching-card preference; optional questions can be skipped and corrected.
Unknown/missing/retired assets remain unavailable; the planner does not invent courses or silently enroll anyone.
Preview what preferences would be retained, where, and for what purpose; raw interview retention is off by default.
Show why this plan fits goal, time and prerequisites; actual profile persistence depends on MD-03 and its gates.
tasks.scope: Design first; any prototype remains memory-only until owned persistence is authorized.
tasks.could_weaken: Profiling, repeated-question burden, hidden assumptions or fabricated competence.

tasks.title: Assess the actual Hermes and inference paths
tasks.deliverable: A tested identified Hermes presentation bridge and, separately if justified, one approved model path.
acceptance: Keep host bridge and model adapters separate; do not assume desktop profile separation is containment.
Pin actual installed host, extension and dependencies; test load/unload, fallback and all admitted execution paths.
Live inference requires approved endpoint/model, minimum context, explicit budget, deadlines/cancellation and no silent cloud fallback.
A presentation-only pass is not agent-control assurance; existing codecs/fixtures remain distinct from live-provider results.
tasks.scope: Presentation assessment first in an expressly permitted environment; model work optional and separately authorized.
tasks.owner_role: Runtime engineer and independent security reviewer
tasks.could_weaken: Broad inherited tools, opaque transmission, authority granted by a model.

tasks.title: Package one install-to-first-value experience
tasks.deliverable: One identified-platform desktop release candidate: one installer, short discovery, useful mission, verified continuation.
acceptance: Select and record one initial OS/architecture and supported resource envelope before release engineering.
No nurse terminal, Python, Docker or model-key setup is required for the base learning mission.
Preserve an existing Hermes home and personal state; host bundling/adapter requires MD-05 native evidence or remains excluded in a clearly standalone candidate.
Verify code-signing/update chain, dependency and rights inventory, least privilege, clean-machine install, upgrade rollback and user-controlled uninstall/data handling.
Large model weights and external connectivity are optional disclosed choices, not first-run surprises.
tasks.scope: Release specification now, not an installer. No purchase of certificates, privileged installation or release signing in this slice.
tasks.could_weaken: A convenient download can distribute unsafe defaults or destroy existing user data.

tasks.title: Extend reviewed roles and hosted personal access
tasks.deliverable: Role mission packs on the same core, then a separately reviewed hosted personal workspace.
acceptance: Student, staff nurse, leader-manager, educator and non-health-care ally retain different purposes, boundaries and evidence requirements.
New packs inherit neither educational validity nor rights automatically; maintain separate code, model and content rights.
Hosted identity and isolation cover database/files/indexes/cache/queues/logs plus backup, restoration and deletion.
A hosted preview, subscription or role selector cannot enable institutional use; patient/employer-confidential/EHR/clinical execution stays excluded.
tasks.scope: Later expansion; no five parallel products or hosted launch promised in this sprint.
tasks.could_weaken: Expansion before usefulness, cross-user leakage or institutional boundary erosion.

content_preparation_basis: User requested next steps after MD-01; candidate preparation only.
